title: SimpleCreators
description: A lightweight creator platform selection plugin for Minecraft servers.
body:
# SimpleCreators

**SimpleCreators** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that lets approved creators choose their main content platform once.

It is designed for creator-focused servers that use LuckPerms for ranks and TAB/chat plugins for display formatting.

SimpleCreators does **not** handle prefixes, nametags, chat formatting, or TAB styling directly. Instead, it runs configurable console commands after a creator selects their platform, allowing LuckPerms and your existing server setup to handle the rest.

---

## Features

- One-time creator platform selection
- Fully configurable platforms
- Works with LuckPerms groups through console commands
- Confirmation system to prevent accidental selections
- Admin reset command for staff appeals or mistakes
- Admin set command for manually assigning a platform
- Info GUI with creator status and selection information
- Configurable messages using MiniMessage
- YAML-based player storage
- Tab completion for commands
- Lightweight and easy to configure

---

## How it works

Staff approve a player by giving them access to the creator selection permission, usually through a LuckPerms Creator group.

The creator then runs a command such as:

```text
/creator set youtube
